reason: The selected five-zone source model improves shot-level heldout likelihood and Wembanyama reconstruction, but all four seasons regress on overall on-court opponent paint FG% MAE versus v44. On/off paint make error also worsens in the four-season mean. Team scoring regression alone is not the rejection reason.

targetSeasonWembanyama.remainingIssue: Off-court restricted-area FG% is too high; other-paint shot deterrence remains too weak; midrange make defense remains inaccurate. Correct on-court paint FG% does not imply correct on/off or every subzone.

sourceEvidence.interpretation: The deterioration is already present before simulation. Better fine-zone shot likelihood does not guarantee smaller player-level aggregated paint FG% errors. Source attribution, shrinkage and zone aggregation need separate ablations; a causal explanation has not yet been established.
sourceEvidence.cornerChoiceFeatureEvidence: Only a tiny heldout likelihood gain; not strong evidence of a distinct corner deterrence mechanism.
